remarks: Absolutely turnkey! Unit 523 has been meticulously renovated with high-end finishes and hardwood floors throughout the first floor. The gourmet kitchen features an Italian gas range and double oven, SubZero appliances, refrigeration drawers, and a large island with seating. The first-floor primary suite has four custom closets, and the luxury en-suite bathroom includes a walk-in shower, Waterworks fixtures and radiant heat floors. Outside, enjoy pristine landscaping and a newly expanded, private bluestone patio. The two-car garage has been upgraded with built-in storage cabinets, new sheetrock, and flooring. New roof is being installed this month. Move right in and enjoy all that Lyon Farm has to offer. HOA + Weaver St tax + condo fee = approx. $1560/month
